info.title: Battleship
info.author: AleixMT
info.description: The classic Battleship game, in C, for the Switch console.
info.details: Single-file homebrew: pick a board size, place ships automatically or by hand, and play human-vs-human, human-vs-CPU or CPU-vs-CPU. Menu is D-pad navigable; text entry uses the system keyboard. Built from the same source that also runs on desktop x86/64.
